name: evez-tools
description: Distributed tool discovery, policy-gated invocation, and auditable orchestration for the EVEZ agent mesh.

interface.longDescription: A safety-first toolkit and reference registry for discovering tools as services across EVEZ, authorizing per-agent capabilities, validating schemas, bounding invocations, governing high-risk calls through Hermes policy, and recording tamper-evident audit evidence. Includes deployment guidance for Hermes and OpenClaw, without claiming access to remote hosts until an actual connection is configured.
defaultPrompt: Help me design or implement an EVEZ distributed tool service.
Review a mesh tool for security, schemas, and auditability.
Plan a safe Hermes and OpenClaw integration for EVEZ tools.
